info.name: Create Brand HotelGroup Hotel - TC089 to TC098 - Existing Corporate
info.description: Data-driven Postman collection for TC_089 to TC_098. Login is manual. Set authToken and loggedInUserId before running. This collection does not create a Corporate. It uses existing Corporate ID 3220 and creates Brand, Hotel Group, and Hotel for each test case under that Corporate. Date formats are restricted to MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, and DD-MMM-YYYY. Timezone offsets from the sheet are mapped to timezone abbreviations before sending payloads.

function timezoneAbbreviation(offset, country) { const timezoneMap = { 'UTC-05:00': 'EDT', 'UTC-06:00': 'CST', 'UTC-03:00': 'BST', 'UTC+00:00': 'UTC', 'UTC+01:00': 'CEDT', 'UTC+02:00': 'SAST', 'UTC+03:00': 'AST', 'UTC+04:00': 'GST', 'UTC+05:30': 'IST', 'UTC+09:00': 'JST', 'UTC+10:00': 'AEST', 'UTC+12:00': 'NZST' }; if (offset === 'UTC+08:00' && country !== 'USA') { return 'CST'; } return timezoneMap[offset] || offset; }
